_README: App Analysis-page metrics. Regenerate with `python model/rt_app_metrics.py` after a retrain; commit predictor/model/metrics.json and reboot the app.
generated: regenerated 2026-06-30 from the 432-image retrain (model/outputs_final/metrics_full.json); train/val/test errors from rt_finalize_eval.py. Re-run model/rt_app_metrics.py to refresh.

task.name: Door-Hanging Safety Classifier
task.description: Binary image classification: is a passenger hanging on the door of a bus/leguna (unsafe) or not (safe)?
task.split: 70/15/15 stratified by vehicle x class (train 302 originals -> 1600 after train-only A-Z augmentation / val 65 / test 65). Val & test are real originals - no leakage.
task.primary_metric_note: Because data is imbalanced 2.1:1, watch UNSAFE-RECALL (catching violations), not just accuracy. An 'always safe' model already scores 67.6% accuracy while catching 0 violations.

human_level.definition: Careful expert reviewing the full-resolution image (can zoom). Used as the Bayes-error proxy.
human_level.why_not_zero: Tiny / distant hangers occupy only 1-8% of a cluttered frame; some borderline poses are genuinely ambiguous (a passenger leaning vs hanging); and inter-annotator agreement on subjective safety labels is only ~0.70-0.85. So neither a human nor a model reaches 0% error.
human_level.sota: Controlled bus boarding/posture detection reaches 96-98% (MDPI Sensors 2026; MDPI Appl. Sci. 2025); real-world clutter drops naive systems to 72-75%; inter-annotator agreement for subjective safety labels is ~0.70-0.85 (Claru; PaSBench-Video). => clear images ~97-98%, borderline subset ~80-85%, blended ~96%.

error_analysis.summary: On the untouched 65-image test set the Ensemble makes 9 errors (2 missed-unsafe + 7 false-alarms) at the balanced operating point. Misses are tiny/distant hangers; the linear/HOG models make many more errors, confirming the deep features help.

per_model_counts._note: Per-model errors on the held-out TEST (n=65), balanced operating point, split into false-positive (safe->unsafe) and false-negative (unsafe->safe, the safety-critical misses).

categories.fixable: Hard - tiny/distant hangers need higher-res / crop inference
Partly - threshold tuning + more varied safe images

diagnosis.verdict: Improved by more data - recall ceiling broken; now mild overfitting.
diagnosis.reasoning: The expanded set added unsafe images (98 -> 140), which lifted the best ROC-AUC past the old ~0.93 plateau to 0.949 (Ensemble) and raised the zero-miss (100%-unsafe-recall) operating point from ~26% to ~57-69% accuracy. Deep nets still fit train ~0% with a 13-18 pt train->test gap, so the remaining error is variance-leaning - more (and more varied) unsafe images would help further, but the hard data ceiling no longer binds.
